_meta.phase_in_status: 100% V28 in CY 2026 (final year of 2024-2026 phase-in)
_meta.scope: Curated subset of the highest-confidence primary-care HCCs. Full population (~10K rows) requires running scripts/build-hcc-v28-seed.js against the CMS-published mapping CSV. This curated seed is enough for Phase 1 unit tests + a working coding-agent on the most common chronic conditions.
_meta.verification_required: Each row's hcc_v28_number should be re-verified against the CMS 2026 Model Software CSV before any production use. Comments below each row note the citation.
